nodes.description: msg.sender: caller address that owns/seeks allowance over token balances in transfer, approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): addition with overflow require(c >= a)
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): subtraction with require(b <= a)
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): multiplication with overflow check
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): division with require(b > 0)
REDSToken constructor: initializes symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-mints balances to fixed owner address
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner]
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd
approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without double-spend checks
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves tokens using allowance and balances with safe math
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): approves then calls arbitrary spender contract's receiveApproval
fallback function () public payable: reverts all plain ETH transfers
